source.code:
theorem fromBitsC_le : ∀ (bs : List Bool), fromBitsC bs ≤ bs.length * (2 * bs.length + 2) + 1
  | [] => by simp [fromBitsC]
  | b :: bs => by
      simp only [fromBitsC, List.length_cons]
      have h1 := fromBitsC_le bs
      have h2 := natC_of_lt_pow (fromBits_lt bs)
      nlinarith
